topic: Jimenez Depth-of-Field sample-CoC intersection gate vs center-CoC foreground halo bleed rig
topic_zh: Jiménez 景深采样点弥散圆相交门控对比中心弥散圆聚集对焦前景光晕渗漏
scope: Deterministic Jorge Jimenez (SIGGRAPH 2014) / Unreal Engine 5 Diaphragm Depth-of-Field sample-CoC intersection gating (w(y->x) = H(CoC(y) - |x-y|)) versus naive center-CoC gathering and 64-tap bokeh gather quadrature across 17 silhouette boundary pixels (d in [-4, +12] px). No neural bokeh rendering execution.

protocol.function: w(y → x) = H(CoC(y) − ∥x − y∥) → In-Focus CoC_fg = 0 Never Bleeds onto Background (L = 1.0000)

robustness.name: Sampled 17 silhouette boundary stations keep sharp in-focus foregrounds from bleeding onto out-of-focus backgrounds

good_fit: Post-process Depth-of-Field bokeh gathering in UE5 Diaphragm DoF, Call of Duty, Frostbite, and Unity HDRP
Explaining why gathering by CoC_center(x) alone causes sharp in-focus foreground characters (CoC = 0) to bleed 8-px halos onto blurry backgrounds
Weighting each gather tap y by smoothstep(0, 1, CoC(y) - ||x - y||) so only truly defocused samples spread across neighbors
Separating far-field background defocus (sample-CoC gated) from near-field foreground defocus (TileMax dilated)
not_for: Infinite depth-of-field pinhole cameras (f/64) where CoC = 0 everywhere
2D Gaussian blur filters on flat UI panels without a 3D depth buffer
Neural single-image portrait mode depth-of-field synthesis
Chromatic aberration or lens flare passes (which operate in screen-space radial coordinates rather than depth CoC)
